ticker_news.title: Is ChargePoint Stock a Millionaire Maker Stock?
ticker_news.description: ChargePoint, an electric vehicle charging station company, has seen its stock price plummet over 90% since going public in 2021. The article discusses the company's challenges, including competition from Tesla, stalled growth, and financial concerns, and suggests it is more likely to cause further losses than generate millionaire-making gains.
ticker_news.author: Leo Sun

ticker_news.title: Don't Chase the Rally: Tesla Just Became the Most Expensive Stock in the $1 Trillion Club by a Wide Margin
ticker_news.description: Tesla's stock has surged 30% since former President Trump's reelection, but the company is facing slowing EV sales growth and increasing competition. The article cautions investors against chasing the rally, as Tesla's valuation is now the most expensive in the $1 trillion club.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool
